notes.title: Major patch (1.3) has been released includes a new map and many changes!
notes.content:
Bug fixes

1: Fixed bug where default slope factor was loaded rather than correct saved value 
2: Fixed bug in static chart where wind speed was not converted from MPH to meters per second under metric units. 
3: Fixed scope cant error cause by quaternion order. 
4: Minor bugs in ballistics model.

Changes 

1: For consistency rifle is no longer rezeroed under static chart conditions.
2: Changed default latitude to 38 degrees

Features 

1: new procedural sky box with 3d volumetric animated clouds
2: New ballistic chart settings to hide chart 
3: Increased range on charts to 1500 yards 
4: Switched from a dual camera rendering system to a triple camera rendering system now possible to view objects as far as 2001 meters away. 
5: Made zoom a button 
6: Powder temperature now effecting rifles zero.  More rigorously defined powder temperature you now need to enter the temperature at which muzzle velocity was measured.
7: Upper and lower limit for wind speed settings

New

Update includes a new map

notes.title: Instructional Videos for Expert Rifleman – Reloaded
notes.content:
Instructional videos from the original version of Expert Rifleman are under the Video tab in the Community Hub. These videos explain how to use Expert Rifleman. The videos cover the following topics:
 
·  How to use a ballistic calculator
·  How to create / customize ammunition types
·  How to create / customize your own ranging reticle image(s)
·  How to range targets using Mil-Dot and similar reticles
·  How changes in environmental conditions affect the path a bullet
 
Expert Rifleman – Reloaded can be used as a game since a score is provided after a shooting session. However, the program was designed as a training/simulator for target/long range shooting. A virtual rifle can be setup in the program identical to nearly any rifle. Different ammo types can be tested without having to incur large expenses. The program gives tactical shooters practice without going to the range and expending bullets.
